subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: If one required assurance pass is absent, stale, invalid, non-accepting, or disagrees with another pass, then the system shall apply FR-26's most-restrictive aggregation, preserve every surviving finding and pass result, and prevent acceptance until the exact revision completes a satisfying full pass set
intent: aggregate review remains non-accepting and names every contributing pass outcome
fit_criterion: missing-pass, stale-pass, split-verdict, and conflicting-finding fixtures never accept from a favorable subset, preserve all pass evidence, and converge only after the full exact-revision set satisfies FR-25/FR-26
